name: [🥶] Grow Glacier For Brainrots
desc:
Grow Glacier For Brainrots 🧊🗻

🎯 Capture a Brainrot before the Guards get to you!
💸 Place it on your plot and upgrade, they'll help you get rich!
⛏  Use your cash to grow your Glacier to help you climb to new clouds!
🧠 Capture new Brainrots to help grow your collection!

👍 Like and favorite if you enjoyed the game!
